data.text:
Madhusudan vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 22 
August, 2024 
Author: Sashikanta Mishra
Bench: Sashikanta Mishra
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Ablapl No. 6017 of 2024
 Madhusudan .... Petitioner
 Dalabehera
 Mr. M. Padhy, Advocate
 -Versus -
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
Order_ 22.08.2024 Order No. 1.  This matter is taken up through hybrid mode. 01 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State. 
3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Paralakhemundi P.S. Case No. 358 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 697 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Paralakhemundi for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 272/273/420/482/483/34 of IPC read with Section 20 of the Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products Act and Sections 51/52/56/59/63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
4. It is alleged that the petitioner was the driver of the vehicle in which the tobacco products were being transported. 
5. Having regard to the nature of accusations and the materials on record, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner. The ABLAPL is however, disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail. In such event, he shall be released on bail on such terms and condition as the court below may deem fit and proper to impose. 
6. The ABLAPL is disposed of. 
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application. 
(Sashikanta Mishra) Judge B.C. Tudu/AKB Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Madhusudan vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 22 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63124141/
